in_sanskrit.name: नान्दकिषोर
in_sanskrit.meaning: Blissful, Joyful, Delightful, Nourishing, Bestowing Happiness
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: नान्द (Nand) - Blissful, Joyful, Delightful, किषोर (Kishor) - Nourishing, Bestowing Happiness

in_hindi.name: नान्दकिषोर
in_hindi.long_meaning: नान्द (Nand) - प्रसन्न (प्रसन्नता) [Blissful, Joyful, Delightful], किषोर (Kishor) - प्रदाता (Pradaat) [Bestowing], खुशी (Khushi) [Happiness]

in_tamil.name: நான்தகிஷோர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: நான் (Nand) - ஆனந்தம் [Blissful, Joyful, Delightful], கிஷோர் (Kishor) - வைத்தல்பார் [Bestowing]

in_telugu.name: నాన్దకిషోర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: నాన్ (Nand) - ఆదేశ్యపోయే [Blissful, Joyful, Delightful], కిషోర్ (Kishor) - ఆదేశ్యపోయేయోగేశ [Bestowing]

in_marathi.name: Nandkishor
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Joy (Nand) Giver of Happiness (Kishor)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nandkishor हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nand means joy, bliss, pleasure, or delight. Kishor means youth, a young man, or the giver of happiness. Together, Nandkishor means the one who bestows joy and happiness.

in_bengali.name: Nandkishor
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Joy (Nand) Giver of Happiness (Kishor)
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nandkishor একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Nand means joy, bliss, pleasure, or delight. Kishor means youth, a young man, or the giver of happiness. Together, Nandkishor means the one who bestows joy and happiness.
